summary: Orbit Quest is designed to introduce students to the challenges of planning a space mission. Players must balance spacecraft mass, power generation, budget, scientific instruments, propulsion, and communications. The simulator provides an interactive environment where students can experiment with engineering decisions and observe their effects on mission success. It encourages scientific curiosity, logical thinking, and problem-solving. The project was developed using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and AI-assisted coding.
details: Orbit Quest is an interactive Space Mission Simulator that helps students understand space exploration and spacecraft engineering. Players can select a mission destination, choose a launch vehicle, design a spacecraft, and manage limited resources such as budget, mass, and power. The game demonstrates how engineering decisions affect mission readiness and scientific outcomes. It makes complex space mission planning easier to understand through interactive gameplay and educational simulation. AI assistance was used to help develop the project concept and generate the initial game code.
